# Welcome To Haunted Warehouse


This is a Creative-looking mod that is a horror based creative mod, this contains a lot of blocks and items.




## FramedBlocks & a Crawl Mod is Recommended!

Mod is the Official Mod for the Roblox Games of mine.

Creepy? Game all the way up to Creepy: Killer in the Mansion.





This Mod Features:



- Few Game Mechanics like Flushing Toilets, Flashlights, and many more

Wide Variety of Blocks, Acid Blocks, Wallpapers, flooring, exc



### This does have many bugs

- There May be a few Blocks or items that may not be fixable due to how mcreator is, but i'll try and fix most of them.
